gen-audiowide-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta reads wide and friendly, its tall-bodied small letters spaced out like they have room to spare. Audiowide adds the futuristic, techy edge up top.
gen-eater-gf-montserrat-alternates: Dark and a bit menacing, Eater spreads its letters wide with chunky stems and slim turns, while Montserrat Alternates stays rounded and uniform. Its lowercase moves along smoothly.
gen-flavors-gf-lexend-giga: Flavors towers with a stubby, pencil-thick x-height and whimsical diagonals as heavy as its stems. Lexend Giga does the opposite job, spacing out flat, single-weight sans lines so each word opens up.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-lexend-mega: Autour One keeps a clear channel leading into each round letter, with no jump between hairline and stem, so it feels bold and expressive. Lexend Mega works well a notch smaller.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-lexend-peta: Commanding and spaghetti-like, Funnel Display draws every stroke at the same width, with c tips that never creep toward closing. Lexend Peta handles the steady work, its curves never thinning.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa sets sans curves wide open, with stubby ascenders tucked next to a big x-height and a line that never changes thickness. Goldman earns its keep big and short, where its widely set letters can stretch out.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-lexend-zetta: Grandstander is bold and expressive, with plain constant-width lines and short ascenders over a tall x-height. Lexend Zetta backs it with sans-serif letters that are widely tracked and just as friendly, so the page feels open.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera reads like a plotter pen at work, one clean line with open curves and letters spaced like stepping stones. And Gugi adds a distinctive, bold voice with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-montserrat-altern: Metamorphous carries large sidebearings and a high-set midline, with only a soft step between its fat and slim strokes. Montserrat Alternates has no such contrast at all.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-lexend-e: Expressive and bold, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders low and its beat level, with terminals pointing outward. And Lexend Exa carries a long read with wide-open curves in a plain sans that never changes thickness.
